observations.facts: Search selects configured Tavily/Serper with configured key; failure/missing configuration falls through to DuckDuckGo. Provider transport and body consumption are runtime effects, not newly implemented. Exact request query trim/slice240 and numeric-string limit conversion/clamp1..12/default6; output total is returned row count, not corpus total.

Tavily/Serper rows normalize whitespace/trim and UTF16 title180,url2000,snippet320,publishedAt40 with three-dot truncation. publishedAt always present string|null and is not a canonical date. URL admission in this projection is case-insensitive HTTP(S) prefix, not safe/fetchable destination proof.

DuckDuckGo HTML projection omits publishedAt, retains raw decoded URL without fabricated HTTP rule, and applies title180/snippet320 summary caps. Duplicate rows are not deduplicated. Provider fallback failure throws rather than producing a success error envelope.

Page URL trim/slice2000; arbitrary case-sensitive mode trim/slice20/defaultsummary; exact extract changes default maxChars12000 versus4000, numeric-string clamp500..20000. Guarded final URL can differ after redirects. HTML byte decode is fatal UTF8; normalized readable probe capped maxChars+1, then summarized maxChars. Truncated HTML fills window, ends with three dots, totalChars null. Raw fetched bytes—not output text—own contentHash.

Embedded PDF worker is parsed as data only, never compiled/imported/executed. It normalizes full parsed text, reports full UTF16 totalChars/pages, and returns first maxChars+1 units. Wrapper normalizes that prefix again then summarizes maxChars. Truncated PDF fills window but can lack ellipsis when the extra prefix unit is trimmed space. PDF title null/links empty and coverage.pages copies pages. Hash is raw PDF bytes. Exact prefix truth and hash bytes cannot be independently established from this DTO.

Legacy source owner performs URL/credential checks, resolution/address pinning, guarded redirects, scoped body limits and cleanup. None is copied or exercised by this contract. Contract URL syntax alone intentionally proves no private-address/DNS/rebinding/egress admission. Content type branch uses lowercased header/PDF suffix rules, not MIME authenticity.

Controller requires standard_user rank via RolesGuard; tool route uses configured service-secret guard and request-active control. Actual current actor/tenant/service permission and cancellation remain separate prerequisites. Model arguments/context cannot supply authority.

limits: No provider request/response authenticity, snippet completeness, current availability, hash readback, parse correctness or safety is proven.

Legacy search helper fetch timeout does not establish full provider-body/JSON deadline; DuckDuckGo uses ordinary fetch/text. This source contract does not qualify those legacy transport paths or copy them.
New approved SDK/provider and isolated page/PDF execution path must establish budgets/current authority/egress/cleanup independently; no spend or execution authorized.
Only standalone contracts reviewed; canonical registration/integration remains root-owned and all existing source availability stays unchanged.
